subject.title: Request: Add Discord reaction event support to Hooks system

question: Should OpenClaw add a public observation-only plugin hook for reaction add/remove events now, and should that contract be Discord-only or a generic cross-channel reaction hook?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but hook names, payload shape, enrichment cost, and cross-channel parity become durable plugin API and need maintainer direction before a fix PR should change the SDK.

options.title: Generic observation hook
options.body: Add reaction_added/reaction_removed as channel-generic observation hooks with structured payloads and Discord as the first implementation, leaving wake behavior to the separate reaction-triggered-turn work.

options.title: Discord-only hook first
options.body: Add a narrower Discord-scoped hook now and defer cross-channel normalization, accepting possible future API churn or an additional generic hook later.

options.title: Defer hook API
options.body: Keep reaction visibility as session system events for now and require plugin authors to wait for a broader non-message event contract.

recommendation.title: Generic observation hook
recommendation.body: Add reaction_added/reaction_removed as channel-generic observation hooks with structured payloads and Discord as the first implementation, leaving wake behavior to the separate reaction-triggered-turn work.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent hook-types blame and plugin SDK review history make vincentkoc the best available owner for the public hook contract decision.
